title: Capricorn plans a goals whiteboard
old_caption:
A date where you plan your goals on a whiteboard?
Their date added "dance in the kitchen" and Capricorn circled it twice.

title: Aquarius plans a time capsule
old_caption:
Make a time capsule together and open it next winter.
A spoon, a ticket, a duck and two notes for future you.

title: Pisces plans letters out loud
old_caption:
Write each other letters, then read them out loud.
Pisces wrote nine pages. Their date wrote two lines. Both cried.

title: Gemini plans a bus to the last stop
old_caption:
The plan was no plan, and the last stop turned out to be a car park.
A tiny soup window saved the night, and THE STARS still gave it a 9. Would you get on the bus?

title: Cancer plans walking shelter dogs
old_caption:
Six dogs, one system, and Capricorn spun into a maypole by minute two.
The shyest dog picked Capricorn and the oldest one got Cancer crying. Muddy, and a 10. Would you sign up?

title: Leo plans a living-room talent show
old_caption:
Leo booked six acts for Leo and gave Virgo act seven.
The card trick flopped, and Leo answered with the loudest standing ovation of the night. Who claps hardest for you?

title: Capricorn plans half a date
old_caption:
Capricorn planned a greenhouse with a printed map. Sag planned a dance class.
The freeze in the dance circle didn't last, and both envelopes said the same thing. Which half would you plan?

title: Aquarius plans a laundromat date
old_caption:
Laundry night with talk cards, and the first question got a very specific answer.
One red jumper later everything was pink, and Taurus loved it. What small thing makes your day?

title: Pisces plans a walk with one umbrella
old_caption:
One tiny umbrella, one gust, one bus right through the puddle.
Pisces swore it was the rain. Scorpio laughed all the way to the bus shelter. Soaked, and a 10. Worth it?

title: Opened With "hey"
old_caption:
You matched, you typed "hey," you hit send. Now what?
Give them something to answer, like a question about their photo.
